clue.text: Trespassers assert charge to be out of order

indicators.note: things out of order are jumbled, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some intruders insist that a charge brought against them is improper.
explanation.definitionFit: Gatecrashers enter a party or event uninvited, which makes them a kind of trespasser.

clue.text: Happy with jewel secure in case

parts.note: happy means glad
a jewel is a precious stone
to bag something is to secure or capture it

explanation.surface: A cheerful owner keeps a precious gem locked safely inside a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gladstone bag is a hinged leather travelling bag, a type of luggage case named after the Victorian prime minister.

clue.text: Idea showing consideration

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a notion or concept in the mind
second meaning: careful attention or regard

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a single mental notion and the act of reflecting carefully or showing regard for others.

clue.text: Feature of a dinner service

parts.note: a chin is one of the features of the face

explanation.surface: Asks what one notable element of a set of dining plates might be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feature' reads as a property of the crockery, but it is a facial feature.
explanation.definitionFit: China is fine porcelain, and the word is used for a set of crockery such as a dinner service.

clue.text: A nurse of spirit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: nurses are affectionately called ...
second meaning: a heavenly spirit or messenger

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a heavenly being and is also an affectionate name for a kind, caring nurse.

clue.text: Place of retreat three magi rebuilt

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together anew, so the letters of the two words are reassembled

explanation.surface: The Wise Men reconstruct a refuge where travellers might withdraw.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermitage is the secluded dwelling of a hermit, somewhere to withdraw from the world.

clue.text: Having got in, this spinner could get you out straightaway

definitions.text: Having got in, this spinner could get you out straightaway

parts.words: Having got in, this spinner could get you out straightaway
parts.note: a rotating entrance: push through and, if you keep going round, it deposits you back outside at once; 'spinner' and 'got in' also hint at cricket

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a cricket spin bowler dismissing a batsman who has just come in; really it is a rotating entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of entrance turns on a central axis, so going round fully returns you outside.

clue.text: Scowl from one looking healthy

definitions.meaning: second meaning: someone who glows with good health

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means frown angrily; read as glow plus -er it is a person radiant with good health.

clue.text: Very fond of a party, call

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: Someone who loves a party and phoning around about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoring someone means loving them deeply, being extremely attached.

clue.text: The bar is back: have a great time

indicators.note: read as 'is backwards', so the word for the bar is turned round

parts.note: a lever is a bar used to prise or lift

explanation.surface: The pub has reopened, so celebrate and enjoy yourself.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a pub reopening; 'bar' is really a metal bar.
explanation.definitionFit: To revel is to celebrate noisily and enjoy oneself.

clue.text: From returning US soldiers, mother getting foreign letter

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the word for the soldiers is read backwards

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A mother receives a letter from American troops coming home.
explanation.definitionFit: Sigma is the eighteenth letter of the Greek alphabet, so a letter from a foreign script.

clue.text: Stricken by illness, I'd allow for new treatment

indicators.note: the words are treated afresh, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient permits a different therapy to be tried.
explanation.definitionFit: To be laid low is an idiom for being incapacitated, typically by sickness.

clue.text: Concerned with sight, squint finally through old film

indicators.note: the letter goes through, i.e. into the middle of, the other letters

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of squint is taken

explanation.surface: Peering hard at an old movie is a matter of eyesight.
explanation.definitionFit: Optic is an adjective relating to the eye or vision.

clue.text: Cold, and how, the German soup

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
der is the German for the

explanation.surface: An exclamation about chilly German soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Chowder is a thick, creamy soup, typically made with clams or fish.

clue.text: Opening cocktail mixer, one becomes more unsteady

indicators.note: the numeral opens up the mixer, going into its middle

parts.note: a shaker is the container used to mix cocktails
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: After opening a cocktail shaker, the drinker wobbles more.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakier is the comparative of shaky, describing something less steady.

clue.text: Tool for workmen making a bridge

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a wrench used to turn nuts
second meaning: something that spans a gap

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a wrench for turning nuts and, read as span plus -ner, a thing that stretches across like a bridge.

clue.text: Turning to place flags, make a speech and disappear

indicators.note: turning round means the word for laying flags is read backwards

parts.note: to pave is to lay flagstones
to orate is to deliver a speech

explanation.surface: Someone sets out flags, gives a speech, and then vanishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flags' suggests banners, but they are flagstones.
explanation.definitionFit: To evaporate is to turn to vapour and vanish, so figuratively to fade away.

clue.text: A capital city, really African: just the tops?

definitions.text: A capital city, really African: just the tops?

indicators.note: only the top, i.e. first, letter of each word is used

explanation.surface: Asks whether only the heads of a genuinely African capital count.
explanation.definitionFit: Accra is the capital city of Ghana in West Africa.

clue.text: Mangy poodle's internal pain

indicators.note: the answer is inside the letters of these words

explanation.surface: A scruffy poodle is suffering from a stomach ache.
explanation.walkthrough: Gyp is British informal for pain, as in 'my knee is giving me gyp'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gyp is a colloquial British word for pain or discomfort.

clue.text: Crowd of reporters

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a dense throng of people

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a pushing throng of people and also journalists considered as a body.

clue.text: Decrepit canon takes a tumble, being this

definitions.text: Decrepit canon takes a tumble, being this

indicators.note: the words fall over and their letters land in a new order

explanation.surface: A frail old clergyman falls over, as is his habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone accident-prone tends to have mishaps, like a doddery cleric always falling.

clue.text: Half a woolly ball for little dog

indicators.note: only the first half of the word for the ball is used

parts.note: a pompom is a small ball of wool used as decoration

explanation.surface: A tiny dog is like a scrap of a ball of wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Pom is short for Pomeranian, a small fluffy breed of dog.

clue.text: Start to fill clothes-horse, weather so improved?

indicators.note: start means the first letter of fill is taken

parts.note: an airer is a frame for drying clothes, also called a clothes-horse

explanation.surface: Hang washing on the drying rack because the weather is brightening.
explanation.walkthrough: An airer, or clothes-horse, is a folding frame on which washing is dried indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairer weather is better weather, brighter and drier than before.

clue.text: Extra-singular customs

parts.note: more means extra, additional
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.definitionFit: Mores are the accepted customs and conventions of a society.
